changes: Root package.json: added "pretest" = 'node scripts/ensure-dist.mjs', so the npm test lifecycle bootstraps BOTH packages before the full suite (previously validate.commands built only packages/main). New scripts/ensure-dist.mjs: existence-based bootstrap that builds packages/main then packages/utils dist ONLY when absent (never rm+rebuilds a present dist). lattice.config.json: registered node packages/main/dist/tasks/test-suite-utils-autobuild-smoke.js in validate.commands as the permanent fast guard. New packages/main/src/tasks/test-suite-utils-autobuild-smoke.ts (structural guard: pretest->ensure-dist, existsSync-guarded, main-before-utils), packages/main/tests/red/red-fb7b-pretest-builds-utils.mjs (repro-first behavioral RED: build-when-absent + skip-when-present), packages/main/tests/red/red-fb7b-guard-bite.mjs (isolated-fixture guard-family verifier). red-b49d4-harness-registration.mjs: both new red files added to REGISTRATION_EXCLUSIONS. CHANGELOG.md entry documenting the bootstrap and the deferred hardening.
usage: Run 'npm test' (or done_required validation) in a worktree where packages/utils/dist is absent: the pretest fires via the npm lifecycle and runs scripts/ensure-dist.mjs, building packages/main then packages/utils, so the full suite (and its bin/lattice.js sub-tests) bootstrap without 'Missing build artifacts: packages/utils/dist/index.js'.
expectedOutcome: Operator runs 'npm test' with packages/utils/dist absent -> pretest (ensure-dist) auto-builds main then utils -> full suite runs green without the bootstrap-runner missing-utils failure.
actualTranscript: npm test -> pretest (scripts/ensure-dist.mjs): builds packages/main (code 0) then packages/utils (code 0) -> full-suite-runner: 47/47 passed in ~249s, retries=0. No 'Missing build artifacts' error. The structural smoke passes in validate.commands; the guard-bite proves the smoke bites on every broken pretest variant (echo-ok, main-only, build:lab, --prefix build:fast, missing, and a non-existsSync ensure-dist).
outcomeDiff: No difference on the core intent — npm test self-bootstraps packages/utils via the pretest and the full suite is green, exactly as the original acceptanceClaim required. Scope was deliberately narrowed (see limitations): the concurrent-build mutex + content-bound idempotent-build hardening that grew into this story during review was descoped to a dedicated follow-up story under explicit maintainer approval.
limitations: Descoped by explicit maintainer decision: the shared-worktree concurrent-build hardening (crash-safe build mutex + content-bound idempotent build) is NOT in this change — the pretest bootstrap is minimal and existence-based (builds only when a dist is absent). An independent Codex cross-host review found a hand-rolled mkdir mutex + freshness heuristic is a genuine infrastructure problem needing dedicated design; that work and all Codex MAJOR findings move to a dedicated follow-up story (recorded via scope_shrinkage_decision + review_escalation_fallback explicit-human-approval). The behavioral RED and guard-bite are EXCLUDED from validate.commands (they rebuild/manipulate shared dist); the permanent everyday guard is the fast pure-read structural smoke.
pitfalls: Very long: multiple DEV/REVIEW/DONE rounds. (1) Root cause of the recurring pitfall: root npm test full suite fails when packages/utils/dist is absent because sub-tests spawn bin/lattice.js -> bootstrap-runner; validate.commands auto-built only packages/main. (2) A first attempt to also harden concurrent builds (build-lock mutex + --ensure idempotency) drew 4 successive Codex MAJOR findings (age-steal of a live lock holder, reclaim TOCTOU race, mtime/existence freshness fragility) — proving crash-safe build mutual-exclusion is a real infra project, not a reactive patch; it was descoped. (3) DONE lifecycle traps hit here: never commit metadata between done_prepare and story_advance DONE (it self-stales the evidence's storyFilesHash binding); run done_prepare && story_advance DONE as one atomic chain; do NOT set LATTICE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS on done_prepare/done_required_validate (it bakes into effectiveEnvironmentDigest and mismatches the re-check); record host-A reviewer passes only when no cross_host_review is concurrently churning the incremental-eligibility basis.
